newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom at new high, funds buying.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom at new high, funds buying.

text.p: Shares in Portugal Telecom (PT) surged to a record 6,550 escudos, up 2.4 percent on Monday's close, with domestic funds the main buyers, traders said.

Investors were betting on good profit figures of over 50 billion escudos when the company posts its 1996 results on Wednesday. The good performance of foreign bourses was also encouraging interest in the Lisbon market, traders said.
"The average forecast is for 52 billion escudos but it would be enough for it to be slightly higher to send the (share) price) to new records," said one trader.
"Today it looks like the markets woke up thinking of telecommunications. Spain's Telefonica also started strongly," said another.
